en:
The wall wasn't the only thing
that Miu changed...

She also changed her avatar settings
from "<CLT=cltSTRONG>human<CLT=cltNORMAL>" to "<CLT=cltSTRONG>object<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
From human to object?

Which means, the Virtual World treated her
avatar as an <CLT=cltSTRONG>object<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

She could have passed through a wall that
<CLT=cltSTRONG>only non-humans could go through<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I-Is...that right?

Don't get ahead of yourself, Kaito. 
We need to listen to everything Shuichi says.

I already told you. The more you try, the
more you cause us trouble.

It's soooo totally lame that your own
sidekick is dissing you!

Kokichi, enough! I wasn't arguing with him.
I was just explaining—

Heh, I don't care.
That doesn't bother me at all.

It just means even I make mistakes.
Don't worry about it, Shuichi.
O-Okay...

Nee-heehee... It's pretty funny seeing Kaito
try to act all tough like this.

Kokichi... Please refrain from making such
irrelevant and irrational remarks.

So...if Miu messed with the program and 
made a wall only she could go through...

Then her secret route was
through that wall?

That's it, right? Like using a glitch
in a game to walk outside the map!

I bet Miu had a hidden passage like that
in the back of the chapel!

But...even if she could walk through 
walls, was there really a hidden passage?
Cuz Miu said...

No, you're not trapped here. Beyond that
wall is the end of the world. Literally.

Past that wall, nothing exists.
Everything ends there.

She probably lied. There would be no point in
going if there was nothing on the other side.
Miu lied... Huh...

I wonder what the truth is.
There's no way to find out now...

That cum-soaked urinal cake was totally lying
about there being <CLT=cltSTRONG>nothing past the wall<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She lived a life of pride, vulgarity, and
secrets! Lying would be a piece of cake for her!
Kokichi! You no have to go that far!
Stop it! Don't badmouth Mommy!
M-Monotaro?

Listen to you... Talking about Mommy...
like she was a terrible, lying whore...

But Mommy wasn't lying! There was no
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden route<CLT=cltNORMAL> in that Virtual World!
Oooh... There wasn't, huuuh?

Hey! You can't tell them such
an important hint!

Oh! If you say that hint is important,
then I guess it must be true!
Oh, shoot!

Ah, geez...
You're lucky you're cute.

<CLT=cltMIND>Was Kokichi saying all that stuff about Miu
to get the kubs to reveal something?

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I should thank him...but I
have no idea why he does things sometimes.

So, now that we know there's no hidden 
route, why did she manipulate the program?

If there's actually nothing past the wall,
then that setting was meaningless.

Miu wouldn't have done something
meaningless. She would've had a plan.

Yes, Miu definitely wanted to be able
to go through that wall for a reason.

We aren't sure why yet, but once we
solve the mystery of the Virtual World...
Mystery of "Ver-chew-ul World"...?

There have been a lot of strange occurences
in the Virtual World...

If we can determine why, we will also
determine what Miu was up to.

We'll know why she wanted
to pass through the wall.

Alright! Let's clear up those 
strange occurrences!

Y-Yeah! Gonta will help, even though Gonta
not know what you're talking about!

Speaking of strange occurrences, I'm
just plain worried about that one thing...

Remember? That thing that made us
notice all the strange occurrences?
<CLT=cltMIND>The events that led us there...

Umm... That's not what I 
was talking about...

That thing that happened while we were 
looking for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Nyeh?
So what happened?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

No, I'm talking about when we were both 
in the mansion in the Virtual World.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What strange occurrence happened
in the Virtual World?

You mean the <CLT=cltSTRONG>loud sound<CLT=cltNORMAL> that you and I
heard in the kitchen?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>BANG!!!
Ah!?
Wh-What!? What was that sound!?

It sounded as if something was struck
very hard. It came from outside, but...
Hm? You all heard that sound, too?
Yes, in the mansion's kitchen.

But that sound occurred near the chapel.
How did you hear it all the way at the mansion?

First off, sound can't go past 
the map loading point.
Did that sound really come from the chapel?

That sound was something hitting the 
chapel wall. It was real loud.

And we definitely heard it.
We heard Keebo's voice as well.

F-For now let's go outside 
and check—
O-Oh no!
What!?

That was Keebo's voice, right!?
I think I heard him outside! He sounded close!
You heard my voice, too?
What—? That is pretty strange...

Exactly. That has to be some kind of clue
to the mystery of the Virtual World.

Okay, well, let's check the answers later
and try to find all the other clues first.

There was another mysterious phenomenon
in the Virtual World, wasn't there?

Kokichi talk like he notice something...
Pretending not to know?

Even Gonta is suspicious of me? I always 
thought you would be the one to trust me!
S-Sorry! Gonta not mean it like that!

There's no need to apologize to him.
He's probably just lying again.

What was the other strange occurrence?
Did you see it, Shuichi?
<CLT=cltMIND>Another mysterious phenomenon...

<CLT=cltMIND>Something that shouldn't be possible, like
Miu in the mansion or that loud noise...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to remember everything
else that happened in there.
